name: Front
description: Bring Front — your team's customer operations platform for email and other channels like SMS, WhatsApp, and chat — into Claude. Triage your inbox and draft high-quality replies on any conversation. Ask Claude to summarize a customer's history before a call so you walk in with the full picture in seconds. Analyze conversation data to surface trends across inboxes and accounts, generate reports for stakeholders, and spot emerging issues before they escalate. Because Claude reads the full omnichannel timeline — customer messages, internal comments, assignments, status changes — in one view, it reasons across the full complexity of a customer interaction. Paired with your other connected tools, it can reply and organize work faster and with richer context, so your team delivers exceptional service at scale.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Front to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Front to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.frontapp.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Front MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Front lists 23 MCP tools, including add_comment, assign_conversation, create_draft, delete_draft, get_attachment, list_channels, list_drafts, list_inboxes, list_statuses, list_tags, list_teammates, and list_teams.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Front?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Front in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and DevRev.
Front requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Front is developed by Front. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
